correctness.rationale: For sorted uniform locations, omitting report i costs its nearest-neighbor distance δ_i and its lottery probability is δ_i^-2/Σδ_j^-2. With n-1 facilities, the optimum is the minimum adjacent gap g*. Thus exact conditional expected approximation ratio R_n=(Σδ_i^-1)/(g* Σδ_i^-2). Uniform spacings are normalized iid exponentials, whose common normalizer cancels. The adjacent-minima identity produces A_n=2ΣE_j^-1-Σmax(E_j,E_(j+1))^-1 and analogous squares. The first sum divided by n log n converges in probability to one by truncation while corrections have finite mean; the square sum is controlled by its extreme point process and corrections vanish on n² scale. Joint scaled minimum and square sum converge to the first and all inverse-squared arrivals of a unit-rate Poisson process. Slutsky yields R_n/log n => 1/(T_1 Σ_j T_j^-2), strictly positive nonconstant. Independent exact rational profiles (3<=n<=7) checked cost ratio and adjacent corrections; numerical samples cannot prove the limit.
